text:
Type: upholstered parsons dining chair
Use: dining, occasional seating; dining room, living room
Style: traditional, classic, farmhouse
Materials: linen-look woven fabric, silver nailhead trim, dark stained wood legs
Colors: warm cream, dark espresso brown, pewter
Shape: tall camelback top with nailhead border, armless, padded seat, slightly flared back legs, tapered front legs, upright and stately
Feel: elegant, soft, inviting
Goes with: dark wood tables, neutral walls, brushed nickel accents; traditional or farmhouse dining rooms
